title: Embedded Systems
page_title: What is an Embedded System - IGCSE Computer Science Revision

blocks.name: Embedded Systems
blocks.definition:
"5 Describe the purpose and characteristics of an
embedded system and identify devices in which
they are commonly used"

blocks.md:
- An embedded system is a computer system which is used to** perform a dedicated function**, inside a larger mechanical unit
- Examples of embedded systems include

  - **Heating thermostats**
  - **Hospital equipment**
  - **Washing machines**
  - **Dishwashers**
  - **Coffee machines**
  - **Satellite navigation systems**
  - **Factory equipment**
  - **Security systems**
  - **Traffic lights**

blocks.text: What are the properties of an embedded system?

blocks.md:
- They are **small** in size
- They **use less power** than a general-purpose computer
- They have a** lower cost**

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: Always use key examples from the list above and don’t try to use different examples such as a fridge or kettle as these will not appear on mark schemes because although they have a single purpose, most fridges and kettles do not have a CPU.
